retained_rows.assessment_basis: The attributed stolen-credential access and guardrail circumvention directly engage secure functioning under foreseeable misuse. Microsoft establishes the hostile access and describes enforcement action, but the public report does not resolve whether credentials were exposed by the service or customers, which preventive safeguards operated, or whether the remaining risk was unreasonable under Section 1.4(a). Successful authentication with stolen credentials alone does not resolve that broader security-adequacy proposition.
retained_rows.identification_basis: Microsoft's account of stolen credentials and illicit access to a generative-AI service directly raises the OECD secure-functioning/foreseeable-misuse benchmark even though no FC-derived candidate is admitted.
